title: Indigenous Arctic
description: Introduction to the unique ecosystems of the Arctic, its fragile biodiversity and the rich cultures celebrated by Indigenous Peoples and local communities. Examines contemporary issues of the Circumpolar North with a primary focus on Arctic Indigenous Peoples, Arctic knowledge systems, environmental stewardship and policies. Combines course discussions, readings and assignments to enhance understanding of the place of humans in the Arctic today.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ANTH 411, ANTH 393 (if taken in the same topic), ANTH 483 (if taken in the same topic).
